title: Anthropic project: minimum cash-recovery hurdle
definition: Pre-capex cash retention is the share of ultimately collected customer payments left after all contract-attributable cash service costs, cash taxes, and working-capital needs, but before project capex, financing, and warrant effects.
condition: The calculation assumes the entire conditional $11.6B is delivered, earned, and collected. If less is collected, the required retention rate rises.
interpretation: These are nominal recovery floors, not an IRR, NPV, attractive-return threshold, or per-share value. They omit the timing cost of front-loaded capex, financing, equipment refresh, and the contingent warrant. No retention rate or overrun here is management guidance.
nextProof: Before estimating a project return, obtain the full payment and service schedule, cash cost-to-serve, refresh and financing plan, collection and termination conditions, and realized warrant/share effects.
